run_PerfWorkload_profile: run the PerfWorkload profile method to generate cProfile stats for map, one-cache, and two-caches workloads
build_PerfWorkload: build a PerfWorkload instance with a name, folder, cache state, array shape, and batched mode
run_PerfWorkload_run: run a PerfWorkload against a MapArray or Step object in batched or single item mode
test_perf_workloads_equivalent: test that map, one-cache, and two-caches perf workloads produce numerically equivalent results
create_MapArray_compute: create a MapArray pydantic model with an infra.apply decorated compute method that yields transformed numpy arrays
